facts.label: Homes / structures
facts.value: More than 1,650 homes (IAWF); about 3,000 houses (BAMS); more than 4,000 structures destroyed or damaged (Wikipedia)
facts.source: IAWF Wildfire Magazine, "Fire around the globe: Attica region, Greece, July 2018"; Lagouvardos et al. 2019, BAMS, "The meteorological conditions of the 2018 Attica fires"; Wikipedia, "2018 Attica wildfires"

facts.label: Vehicles burned
facts.source: Lagouvardos et al. 2019, BAMS, "The meteorological conditions of the 2018 Attica fires"

facts.label: People evacuated from beaches by boat
facts.value: 715 (navy vessels, yachts and fishing boats; government spokesman, 24 Jul)

facts.label: Warning to residents
facts.value: No warning or organized evacuation reached residents (IAWF). Cell-broadcast 112 alerts started in Greece only in 2020; in 2018 112 was a call line.
facts.source: IAWF Wildfire Magazine, "Fire around the globe: Attica region, Greece, July 2018"; ekathimerini, "Greece activates full service of European emergency number" (1 Jan 2020)

facts.label: Ignition to the sea
facts.value: Under 2 hours; mean head rate of spread about 2.6 km/h, about 4 km/h through Mati with bursts over 5 km/h
facts.source: IAWF Wildfire Magazine, "Fire around the globe: Attica region, Greece, July 2018"

facts.label: Wind at Penteli (NOA station, 495 m)
facts.value: WNW 32-56 km/h, gusts 50-89 km/h; gusts to 25-26 m/s with a lull 1440-1520 UTC
facts.source: IAWF Wildfire Magazine, "Fire around the globe: Attica region, Greece, July 2018"; Lagouvardos et al. 2019, BAMS, "The meteorological conditions of the 2018 Attica fires"

facts.label: Rafina weather
facts.value: 38 C and 17% RH at 16:45 (HNMS); max 39 C, min RH 19% (BAMS); gusts occasionally to 120 km/h (FIRElinks)
facts.source: IAWF Wildfire Magazine, "Fire around the globe: Attica region, Greece, July 2018"; Lagouvardos et al. 2019, BAMS, "The meteorological conditions of the 2018 Attica fires"; Xanthopoulos & Mitsopoulos, "The catastrophic fire of July 2018 in Greece" (FIRElinks)

facts.label: Aerial support
facts.value: One helicopter dropped water 16:50-18:20; no aircraft 18:20-18:45
facts.source: thetoc.gr, timeline from the prosecutor's report

facts.label: Camera evidence
facts.value: Security-camera footage shows fire spreading in Mati from 18:07
facts.source: ekathimerini, "Camera footage shows speed of fire spreading in Mati"
